S.b.meta.title: Uphawu lwe-Lewydo™ — inhliziyo, isikrini sokuqala, isayini yemenyu, Ngathi
S.b.meta.desc: Indlela yokubona i-Lewydo, nakho konke umdlalo we-Lewydo okudingayo ukuze uyibonise ngendlela efanayo: ilogo, imibala, isikrini sokuqala, isayini yemenyu, Ngathi nokushaya kwenhliziyo — namafayela nekhodi.
S.b.nav.label: Ikhasi lophawu
S.b.hero.title: Inhliziyo eyodwa, iyafana yonke indawo
S.b.hero.sub: Indlela yokubona i-Lewydo — nakho konke umdlalo we-Lewydo okudingayo ukuze uyibonise ngendlela efanayo: ilogo, imibala yayo, isikrini sokuqala, isayini yemenyu, Ngathi nokushaya kwenhliziyo. Izithombe nekhodi zikhona lapha, zikhululekile ukusetshenziswa kumaphrojekthi e-Lewydo.
S.b.rec.title: Indlela yokubona i-Lewydo
S.b.rec.sub: Inhliziyo eluhlaza edwetshwe ngesandla emise okwebhamuza lokukhuluma, ekhazimula ngombala we-mint phezu kweluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olujulile lobusuku, negama elimhlophe eliyindilinga ngaphansi kwayo. Noma kuphi lapho uyibona khona, lowo mdlalo siwenze sobabili, ngothando.
S.b.part.heart.d: Idwetshwe ngesandla, imise okwebhamuza lokukhuluma: uyinki omnyama, ukugcwalisa okuluhlaza okunokuthungwa kwetshoki, amachaphaza ambalwa.
S.b.part.glow.d: Ukukhazimula okuthambile kwe-mint (#6DF593) kuzungeze inhliziyo — kuyingxenye yelogo, akusoze kwaba ngumphumela owodwa.
S.b.part.slogan.d: «Love What You Do» — njalo ngesiNgisi, luwuphawu lokuhweba. Izinhlamvu zalo ezigqamile zakha igama.
S.b.part.line.d: Umugqa omncane omhlophe, ububanzi obungu-146, ovala ilogo.
S.b.spell: Igama livela esiqubulweni: izinhlamvu ezigqamile ze-«Love What You Do» zifundeka **Lewydo**. Yingakho isiqubulo singahunyushwa neze.
S.b.where.1.d: Isikrini sokuqala: i-Lockup iyavela, inhliziyo ishaya kanye.
S.b.where.2.d: Iphilisi lesayini — lithephe ukuze wazi isitudiyo.
S.b.where.3.d: I-Lockup ngaphezu kwamagama ambalwa ngathi sobabili.
S.b.rules.title: Yiyeke injalo
S.b.do.2: Gcina imibala, ifonti nezilinganiso: i-Lockup ingu-**208×322**, isayini ingu-**24 + igama**.
S.b.do.3: Vumela inhliziyo **ishaye kanye** lapho uphawu luvela: isikrini sokuqala, Ngathi (njalo uma livuleka), iphilisi lemenyu.
S.b.do.4: Lungisa **ingemuva nokukhanya okuzungezile** kuvumelane nomdlalo wakho — ilogo engaphezulu ihlala ifana.
S.b.do.5: Yibeke engemuva elimnyama (#0E1024 noma ubusuku obumnyama bomdlalo wakho).
S.b.dont.1: Ukudweba kabusha ilogo, ukuyishintsha umbala, ukuyelula, ukuyicindezela, ukuyijikisa noma ukwengeza imiphumela.
S.b.dont.2: Ukuhumusha isiqubulo noma ukubhala igama ngenye ifonti.
S.b.dont.3: Ukuyishayisa ngokungapheli — ilogo ecwayiza njalo iphazamisa umdlalo.
S.b.dont.4: Ukuyibeka engemuva elikhanyayo noma eligcwele izinto.

S.b.games.title: Isikrini sokuqala, amagama abenzi ekulayisheni, Ngathi, isayini yemenyu
S.b.games.sub: Izindawo ezine ezifanayo kuwo wonke umdlalo we-Lewydo, ku-360×800. Ilogo nezinombolo zayo azishintshi neze; ingemuva nokukhanya kungalandela umdlalo — zama:
S.b.ph.loader.d: Ngokushesha ngemva kwesikrini sokuqala, ngezansi kwesikrini sokulayisha somdlalo (hhayi neze esikrinini sokuqala uqobo): ubani owenza umdlalo, ngani, nenguqulo. Inguqulo ngeye-app uqobo, ngakho iyazishintsha ngokwayo ngokukhishwa ngakunye.
S.b.ph.splash.d: Isikrini sokuqala somdlalo ngamunye, ≈ 4 s: ilogo iyafika, bese ukushaya kwenhliziyo nomsindo we-Lewydo, bese kulayisha umdlalo.
S.b.ph.about.d: Inhliziyo ishaya njalo uma i-Ngathi ivuleka. Umbhalo, izinkinobho nenkinobho yokubuyela emuva kungokomdlalo ngamunye; ilogo iyafana.
S.b.mn.title: UMDLALO WAKHO
S.b.ph.menu.d: Isayini ethulile, hhayi isikhangiso: maphakathi, 34 px ukusuka phansi. Ukuthepha → Ngathi (iphilisi liyancipha libe ngu-0.96). Lishaya kanye uma imenyu ivela — lithephe lapha.
S.b.num.1: **Lockup 208×322**: ilogo 208×208 (ukukhazimula kuyayigcwalisa, inhliziyo 140×140 maphakathi) · igama 208×74 · isiqubulo 208×19 · umugqa 146×1, 20 ngezansi
S.b.num.2: **Isikrini sokuqala**: inhliziyo iyafika 0.15→0.85 s · igama 0.55→1.1 nesiqubulo 0.85→1.4 kuyavela · umugqa uyavuleka 1.15→1.85 · isiphetho: ukuphefumula 2.0, «dum» 2.17, «dum» 2.45, amagagasi amabili okukhanya · umsindo kusukela ku-2.09 · 3.8 s → umdlalo
S.b.num.3: **Ngathi**: i-Lockup phezulu ku-108 · umbhalo ku-456, ububanzi 312 · izinkinobho 296×52 ku-584 naku-682 · ikheli lewebhusayithi ku-648 · © ku-764
S.b.num.4: **Iphilisi lesayini**: ukuphakama 28, i-radius 999, umkhawulo 1 px #3DDC84 24 %, ukugcwalisa 4 %, › 5×8 #9DF5C2 65 %, isikhala sangaphakathi 3 / 10, igebe 5; indawo yokuthepha 48
S.b.num.5: **Amagama abenzi ekulayisheni**: Powered by LibGDX · Developed by Lewydo™ · Version + inguqulo ye-app — Inter Medium 10, ukuphakama komugqa 12, mhlophe 25 %, maphakathi; ibhulokhi engu-360×36, 28 ngaphezu komphetho ongezansi (+ indawo ephephile); ngesiNgisi kuzo zonke izilimi
S.b.hb.title: Ukushaya okukodwa, uma uphawu luvela
S.b.hb.sub: Inhliziyo nokukhazimula kwayo kushaya **ngamunye ngokwakhe** — «dum-dum» esheshayo — **kanye** kuphela: uma isikrini sokuqala sivela, njalo uma i-Ngathi ivuleka, uma iphilisi lemenyu livela. Hhayi neze ngokungapheli. Uma «Nciphisa ukunyakaza» kuvuliwe, ayishayi nhlobo.
S.b.dl.title: Iphakethe lophawu
S.b.dl.sub: Izithombe yizona kanye ezivela ku-Figma ezisetshenziswa yimidlalo: ama-PNG @3x anosayizi ongenhla, acacile kunoma yisiphi isikrini. Ama-app athatha ama-PNG noma yonke i-atlas ye-LibGDX; amawebhusayithi angathatha amakhophi e-WebP ezithombe ezifanayo.
S.b.dl.zip.d: Izithombe (PNG + WebP), umsindo, i-atlas ye-LibGDX, ikhodi ye-Kotlin neyewebhu, brand.json
S.b.c.heart.d: brand_front (inhliziyo) phezu kwe-brand_back (ukukhazimula) — izithombe ezimbili, ukuze zishaye ngamunye ngokwayo. Ibhokisi lelogo 208, inhliziyo 140.
S.b.c.name: Igama
S.b.c.line.d: 146×1, 20 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo; esikrinini sokuqala uvuleka usuka maphakathi.
S.b.c.lockup.d: Isithombe esisodwa esibonisa ngale — sezitolo, amavidiyo namaslayidi. Ngaphakathi kwomdlalo, yakhe ngezingxenye zayo (isikrini sokuqala siyazinyakazisa).
S.b.c.pill.d: Iphilisi lemenyu elivela ku-Figma, isithombe esisodwa esibonisa ngale. Ngaphakathi kwomdlalo, lakhe ngezingxenye zalo, ukuze inhliziyo ikwazi ukushaya.
S.b.c.atlas.d: Zonke izithombe ezinhlanu ku-texture eyodwa — assets/atlas/, EnumAtlas.BRAND.
S.b.c.code.d: I-LibGDX (Kotlin) yemidlalo, i-CSS yewebhu — isikrini sokuqala, ukushaya kwenhliziyo, iphilisi.
S.b.dev.title: Faka i-Lewydo emdlalweni omusha
S.b.dev.sub: Konke okungezansi kuku-[repository yewebhusayithi → brand/](https://github.com/RoShevasternin/roshevasternin.github.io/tree/main/brand) naku-[brand.json](/brand/brand.json) (zonke izinombolo, imibhalo ngazo zonke izilimi zemidlalo yethu nezindlela zamafayela — zekhodi nezika-Claude).
S.b.step.1.d: Kopisha `kit/atlas/brand.atlas` + `brand.png` uye ku-`assets/atlas/` kanye ne-`kit/sound/lewydo-heartbeat.ogg` uye ku-`assets/sound/`; izifunda ze-atlas: `brand_back`, `brand_front`, `lewydo`, `slogan`, `brand_line` (i-`assetsBrand` yakho, `EnumAtlas.BRAND`).
S.b.step.2.d: Kopisha i-`LewydoHeartbeat.kt` (iphakheji `com.lewydo.brand`) ne-`BrandScreen.kt`, `ABrandGroup.kt`, `ABrandLogo.kt`; shintsha i-`yourgame` ibe yiphakheji yakho. Zisebenzisa isisekelo se-LibGDX se-Lewydo (AdvancedScreen, AConstraintLayout, AAutoLayout).
S.b.step.3.d: Qala umdlalo ku-`BrandScreen`: ≈ 4 s — ilogo iyafika, ukushaya kwenhliziyo nomsindo we-Lewydo, bese kuba yi-`LoaderScreen`. Xhuma i-`soundVolume()` nevolumu yemisindo yomdlalo wakho: 1.0 ezingeni layo elijwayelekile, iphansi kuphela uma umdlali eyinciphisa.
S.b.step.4.d: Iphilisi ngaphansi kwemenyu (maphakathi, 34 px ukusuka phansi) → Ngathi; ukushaya okukodwa uma imenyu ivela.
S.b.step.5.d: I-Lockup phezulu ku-108, umbhalo wesitudiyo (isiNgisi yisibonelo; zonke izilimi zemidlalo yethu zisefayeleni le-brand.json), «Iwebhusayithi yethu» → `https://roshevasternin.github.io/` nekheli ngaphansi kwayo, «Imidlalo yethu ku-Google Play» → ikhasi lethu lomthuthukisi, «© 2026 Lewydo™». Ukushaya okukodwa njalo uma ivuleka.
S.b.step.6.d: Lungisa ingemuva nokukhanya ngemuva kwelogo kuvumelane nomdlalo wakho — hhayi neze ilogo uqobo.
S.b.prompt: Ka-Claude kwenye iphrojekthi — kopisha lokhu (u-Claude ukufunda ngesiNgisi)
S.b.foot: © 2026 Lewydo™ · Love What You Do. Ilogo ye-Lewydo ingeyethu: yisebenzise kumaphrojekthi e-Lewydo kuphela, futhi kuphela njengoba leli phakethe libonisa.
S.b.hb.finale: Esikrinini sokuqala ukushaya kwenhliziyo **kuyisiphetho**: kuqala kufika yonke ilogo, bese ukuphefumula, «dum» enamandla nenye «dum», amagagasi amabili okukhanya — nomsindo we-Lewydo.
S.b.snd.title: Umsindo we-Lewydo
S.b.snd.sub: Inhliziyo kuphela: ukushaya okubili okuthambile neyindilinga — okokuqala kunamandla, okwesibili kuthulile — ngesikhathi esifanayo nokushaya kwelogo. Ayikho iculo, akukho kukhala: ukubingelela okuthulile nokufudumele.
S.b.snd.r1: Kanye ekuqaleni ngakunye, nesikrini sokuqala — hhayi neze ngokungapheli.
S.b.snd.r2: Ngevolumu egcwele uma imisindo yomdlalo isezingeni elijwayelekile (ukukhulisa 1.0); isilayida somdlali singakwazi ukuyinciphisa kuphela; imisindo icishiwe — ukuthula.
S.b.snd.r3: Ungalishintshi neze, ungalinqumi futhi ungalidlali ngaphansi komculo.
S.b.snd.r4: Ikhasi lewebhu lingalidlala kuphela ngemva kokuthepha; isikrini sokuqala esizidlalela sona sihlala sithulile.
S.b.snd.r5: Ifayela elilodwa yonke indawo: wonke umdlalo, i-prototype yawo yewebhu newebhusayithi yawo kudlala leli fayela kanye, i-byte ngo-byte — elenzelwe izipikha zocingo (iphimbo eliphezulu, iziqongo ku-−1 dBFS) — ukuze i-Lewydo izwakale ngendlela efanayo noma kuphi lapho uyizwa khona.
S.b.say.note: «Lewydo» ngu-«Love What You Do» kushiwo ngokushesha: amalunga amathathu, **Lev-wai-du**.
S.b.dont.5: Ukudlala umsindo ngokungapheli, ngokuzwakala kakhulu kunomdlalo, noma lapho umdlali ecishe umsindo.
S.b.work.title: Kuqala i-prototype, bese umdlalo
S.b.work.lead: Yile ndlela umdlalo ngamunye we-Lewydo owenziwa ngayo.
S.b.work.1: **Konke okusha kuqala ku-prototype.** Isikrini, indlela yokudlala, umbhalo noma inombolo kwenziwa futhi kuhlolwe kuqala ku-prototype yewebhu yomdlalo — kuyashesha ukuhlola kusiphequluli.
S.b.work.2: **Umdlalo uthuthwa kuyo.** Umdlalo (LibGDX: Android, kamuva iOS) uthatha konke ku-prototype, izinombolo namagama kufana ncamashi: i-prototype iyisibonelo.
S.b.work.3: **Hhayi neze ngokuphambene.** Into entsha eyenziwe ngaphakathi komdlalo kuphela, i-prototype ayiyazi, futhi kokubili kuyahlukana. Ngisho nokulungisa: kuqala ku-prototype, bese emdlalweni.
